## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] New adapter or capability changes include a capability map update and contract tests
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, support levels, or the provider matrix changed
- [ ] Changeset added if a publishable package changed (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or provider account identifiers in the diff
